poll.question: Tonight—Dan wants one more scavenge run into the city. Hui Ling wants the van sealed for dawn. Who's right?

options.label: Dan's one more run
options.desc: Trust the scavenger. The city still holds. One last chance before the road.

options.label: Hui Ling's sealed dawn
options.desc: The work is done. Everything loaded. Leave with certainty, not risk.

in_play.label: Open the ramp
in_play.desc: Extend their healing to one more person. They don't just survive—they choose to help.
